$comment: Controlled era vocabulary for Chhelebela Score. Per SRS OD-02/OD-04 these tags are a proposed baseline pending product-owner approval. A multi-era item expresses this with an array of era ids (e.g. ["80s","90s"]); no separate 'multi-era' id is needed. 'neutral' is reserved for era-neutral items (e.g. cricket history known from family stories, per the idea proposal). Evidence outside these ranges (e.g. 1970s) is flagged, not silently recategorized — see review-flags.json FLG-DS-13.

eras.note: Reserved for items experienceable across (or outside) the covered eras, e.g. cricket history known from family stories. No dataset item uses this tag yet — see FLG-DS-09.

usage_rules.item_count_semantics: item_count = number of memory items whose era_tags include this era; multi-era items count toward EACH tagged era, so the sum exceeds the item total (30).
usage_rules.multi_era: Use an array of era ids in era_tags on the memory item; do not double-count in era affinity until OD-05 is decided.
usage_rules.out_of_range_evidence: Evidence pointing outside 1980–2009 (e.g. 1970s, 2010s, 2020 reruns) must be recorded in the item flags, not absorbed into era_tags.
usage_rules.legacy_alias: The spreadsheet tag '00s' is standardized to '2000s'. See data/DATA-CHANGELOG.md.
